Rules.InvariantScript:
Sort(
    Distinct(
        Filter(
            'dim.Ref.Organizations',
            !IsBlank('Wave Number') &&
            'Wave Number' <> "Wave" &&
            'Wave Number' <> "NULL" &&
            !IsBlank('SubWave2 Code') &&
            'SubWave2 Code' <> "SubWave" &&
            'SubWave2 Code' <> "NULL"
        ),
        'Wave Number' & " - " & 'SubWave2 Code'
    ),
    Value,
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

Sort(
    Filter(
        'dim.Ref.Organizations',
        !IsBlank('Facility Mnemonic') &&
        'Facility Mnemonic' <> "Facility Mnemonic" &&
        'Facility Mnemonic' <> "NULL" &&
        (
            IsBlank(gblSelectedWaveNumber) ||
            'Wave Number' = gblSelectedWaveNumber
        ) &&
        (
            IsBlank(gblSelectedSubWaveCode) ||
            'SubWave2 Code' = gblSelectedSubWaveCode
        )
    ),
    'Facility Mnemonic',
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

Sort(
    Filter(
        'Reg Config Categories',
        'Reg Worksheet Name' <> "REG ALL" &&
        'Reg Worksheet Name' <> "REG [INSERT-UPLOAD]"
    ),
    'Reg Worksheet Name',
    SortOrder.Ascending
)
